name: Tvara
positioning: AI Sales Brain for modern sales teams — run your entire sales from one brain.
description: Tvara connects your data, matches the right opportunities, and runs your outreach, so every move is guided, not guessed. Four sales engines work as one system: Matching Engine, Intelligent Campaigns, learning from every interaction, and integration with your existing sales stack across Email, WhatsApp and calls.

founders.name: Shishir Govinda M
founders.focus: Product architecture, AI systems and engineering.

capabilities.label: Matching Engine
capabilities.description: Matches every lead to the right offer, message angle and channel — ranking opportunities by fit, intent and readiness before outreach begins.

capabilities.label: Intelligent Campaigns
capabilities.description: Personalised Email and WhatsApp campaigns where every message and follow-up adapts to buyer context instead of a generic sequence.

capabilities.label: Learns from Every Interaction
capabilities.description: Learns from emails, WhatsApp conversations, calls, objections and outcomes to improve pitches, recommendations and follow-ups.

capabilities.label: Your Existing Sales Stack
capabilities.description: Connects CRM, inbox, WhatsApp, lead sources and business tools — HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive, Gmail, Slack and more — without replacing them.

capabilities.label: Live Buyer Profile
capabilities.description: Builds a real-time behavioural profile per lead — role, intent stage, objection type and channel preference — then routes, matches and fires.

capabilities.label: Context Layer Research
capabilities.description: The research behind Tvara: source-aware compression for stateless LLM inference in business workflows, published in Tvara Research.

milestones.title: Tvara — Startup Exchange, Dubai
milestones.description: Invited to represent Tvara at an exclusive startup exchange, presenting its AI platform and technology roadmap to founders and ecosystem stakeholders.
